approved_recording.use: Approved privacy-masked historical film; genuine launch, public chats, contacts and background UI. Startup theme reproduction is labelled separately.

native_ui.method: Native installed Pyxel drawing on uConsole; isolated empty player state; automatic hardware and network connections disabled; no action activation or injected peers, traffic, fixes or alerts. Private capture archive is not published.

save_dialog.method: Existing actual WDG drawing-code preview using test coordinates; no real fix or assignment created.

modal_context_crop.reason: Exclude unrelated retained framebuffer behind modal panels; modal pixels unchanged.

editing.privacy: Hide exact GPS and authentication material; retain public conversations and nodes as approved. Privacy mattes retained after all visual effects. No fictional counters/messages or telemetry.

music.title: Infraction - Venom (Rave), Instrumental
music.license_scope: Attributed free-track use in a video, separate from repository MIT. No standalone audio source is distributed.

validation.scope: Full decode, privacy-matte interiors and sampled visual review. Not exhaustive OCR of every possible credential or a new RF test.

distribution.full_quality_master: Retained locally for the owner to upload to YouTube; not a tracked source archive asset.
distribution.autoplay: Playback is controlled by GitHub and the browser; press Play and unmute.
